title: Hearty Molten Thai Flax Eggs Bowl
description: A vibrant, savory dish featuring the unique texture of flax eggs, crispy fried tofu, and the flavors of Thailand, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, until it shimmers.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the cooked tofu to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet, then add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Tom Yum paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked tofu back into the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked tofu mixture among four Korean brass bowls, then top with flax eggs, Thai basil, and chili flakes.
